subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Escrever, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, listas de regras e regulamentos que organizam a vida na comunidade escolar, dentre outros gêneros do campo da atuação cidadã, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar propósito comunicativo de gêneros de participação cívica como regras e regulamentos
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose of civic participation genres such as rules and regulations
components.cc_component_description: Identify the main purpose of an informational text

components.description_pt: Reconhecer características estruturais de regras e regulamentos escritos em contextos escolares
components.description_en: Recognize structural features of written rules and regulations appropriate to school community contexts
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

components.description_pt: Escrever lista de regras escolares colaborativamente com apoio de colegas e professor
components.description_en: Write a list of school rules collaboratively with peers and teacher support

components.description_pt: Adaptar conteúdo e linguagem de regras à situação comunicativa e assunto
components.description_en: Adapt content and language of rules to the communicative situation and subject
components.cc_component_description: Adapt writing style to suit a specific audience and communicative purpose

cc_matches.description: Identify the main purpose of a text, including what the author wants to answer, explain, or describe.
Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
